summary: Rigorous verification of /sobre and /parcerias per main-agent request. Ran Playwright with page.on('console'), page.on('pageerror'), and page.on('requestfailed') listeners. Scenarios covered: (1) direct-load /sobre desktop 1920x1080, (2) direct-load /parcerias desktop, (3) navigation from / via nav-sobrenos and nav-parcerias, (4) direct-load both at mobile 390x844, (5) hard reload on both routes, (6) regression on /produtos (3 product cards), /atletas, and /. RESULT: Both pages render cleanly with ZERO console errors, ZERO pageerrors, ZERO React error overlays in every scenario. Only console output is the standard React DevTools info notice. Only failed request is https://.../cdn-cgi/rum (Cloudflare telemetry, unrelated to app). data-testid=sobre-page and data-testid=parcerias-page are both visible in all scenarios. User's reported error CANNOT be reproduced.

rca of the issue: Root cause of user's report is NOT in the frontend code. /sobre and /parcerias render with zero JS errors, zero React overlay, correct data-testid markers, and identical behavior across direct-load, SPA-nav, mobile, and hard-reload.
